record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace dot-product compatibility with h_t^T W e_i, using one jointly trained 128x128 matrix W initialized to identity. Apply W after the unchanged causal interest readout, identically for training and candidate inference. A learned compatibility map may align recurrent states with unit-normalized candidate embeddings without the direct embedding residual that previously regressed. Preserve embeddings, GRU recurrence, history policy, readout, loss and optimizer; update the predictor writer to load W from each category's single checkpoint.

Preserve the GRU, causal interest readout, embeddings, loss and optimizer across all four category models. Record and validate compatibility metadata in the predictor writer; its dynamic model import loads the added checkpoint parameter.
